description: This file defines the AutoLogoutService class responsible for automatically logging out users after a period of inactivity. It manages user activity monitoring, session clearing, and redirection to login page.

classes.name: AutoLogoutService
classes.description: Singleton class that manages automatic user logout after inactivity, including event listener setup and session management.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AutoLogoutService.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service with a router instance for navigation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts monitoring user activity and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops monitoring user activity and removes event listeners.

methods.name: performLogout
methods.description: Performs logout by clearing session and redirecting to login page.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for user activity events.

methods.name: removeEventListeners
methods.description: Removes event listeners for user activity.

methods.name: handleUserActivity
methods.description: Handles user activity events by resetting the inactivity timer.
